name: Ogíjares (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of blue, yellow and blue with the yellow stripe equal in width to the two blue stripes together, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Ogíjares (three blue fesses on yellow, a crescent and a tree).
history: Ogíjares adopted its arms and flag officially on 17 March 2009; the flag is a rectangular cloth of 2:3 divided into three vertical stripes, the central one equal in width to the sum of the other two.

features.role: Ogíjares arms — three fesses, crescent and tree
